data.name: Emotional Combat: Ratio V Motus
data.detailed_description:
Overview: Ratio V Motus. Latin for Reason V Emotion. Logic is the strongest weapon against emotion and thus, your logic must survive combating the mind of emotions. Mimicking the emotional development through ones life, the balance between Reason and Emotional must be kept in order to mature. Mature to victory

Design: A third person combat action and adventure

How to play:

4 Regions are accessible by the Logic Region. This is your place of refuge but once you enter the emotional region, the only exit is your entrance. As for now, the bridge between regions is the emotional orb. Each Primary emotion has an orb with a logic orb being the bridge between emotional regions and to the logic region

Continue through each region taking out each of the bosses. Defeating the bosses right now doesn't do anything but that feature will be added soon. 

The weapons you do have to help you fight is you melee (left click and right click) plus 4 abilities which are

Rationalize: Convert Resistance to health and spawn turret which inflicts damage on emotions but uses 1 mana

Harvest: Convert Resistance to Mana without loss except makes you more exposed to emotions

Deductive Logic: Concentrated ranged weapon with the cost of a decent amount of mana

Inductive Logic: 360 attack with the cost of significant amounts of mana

Anger Region:

  • Chasing of Hate: Large in quantity but fragile anger

  • Sprouts of Rage: Tall sprouts manifesting anger into damaging rage. 

  • Fixed Resentment: Fixed in place and directed to what they resent damaging from afar

  • Pure Vengeance Boss: Pure manifested anger. Damaging in all ways

Happiness region:

  • Leading Optimism: Faster and taller directing forward

  • Sweet Relief: Small and but releasing the damaging pressure

  • Piercing Gratitude: Fixed forwards what is appreciated, resistant to damage

  • Joy Together Boss: Happiness in its fixated form. Most damaging to Logic.

Sadness region:

  • Disappointed Spirit: Plain and simple not meeting expectations

  • Shattered Alone: Shattered pieces floating alone

  • Unplaced guilt: Such in quantity, its unclear what is guilty

  • Utter Despair Boss: Made of the tears of sadness

Sadness region:

  • Tough Love: Love so strong, its resistant to cuts

  • Seeds of Affection: Constant non stop affection

  • Full Devotion: Devoted to showering you with Love and Affection

Do you have what it takes to fight your emotions?

Please Note: This game is in very early development and updates are very frequent including more content and bug patches daily to weekly depending on significance

data.short_description: Ratio V Motus. Reason versus Emotion. You play as Logic itself combating emotions and fighting in the war that has been fought for as long as humanity has existed; Logic Versus Emotions.

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: intel i-7
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070
